Name: Maggie MCH Complete
Description: Complete Machinist event profile based on Jasper's public-duty structure and checked against BossMod priorities. Opener stays enabled; Save CD is manual only; tools, Heat, Battery, Queen, beneficial AoE and automatic interrupt remain enabled.

Events.Name: Second Wind Recovery
Events.Description: Uses Second Wind once personal HP falls near 60 percent.

Events.Name: Out-of-Combat Reset
Events.Description: Returns Machinist ACR toggles to their standard out-of-combat state.

Events.Name: Zone Reset
Events.Description: Machinist defaults are reapplied after changing zones.

Events.Name: Wipe Reset
Events.Description: Machinist defaults are reapplied after a wipe.

Events.Name: Head Graze Cast Stop
Events.Description: Stops interruptible enemy casts with Head Graze when in range.

Events.Name: Arm's Length Self-Guard
Events.Description: Triggers Arm's Length only when you are stationary, pressured, and several mobs are on you.

Events.Name: Damage State Guard
Events.Description: Maintains Machinist burst, AoE, tool, Queen, Checkmate, and utility toggles in combat so imported or held toggle states cannot strand the job in a passive state.

Events.Name: Pack Damage Release
Events.Description: Maintains standard Machinist AoE, tool, Queen, and burst toggles on 2+ enemy pulls while leaving ForceAOE manual.

Conditions.Name: Self HP <= 65%
Conditions.Description: Self HP threshold for earlier Second Wind recovery.

Conditions.Name: Second Wind <= 65%
Conditions.Description: Self HP threshold for earlier Second Wind recovery.

Logics.Name: Second Wind
Logics.Description: Uses Second Wind once personal HP falls near 60 percent.

Logics.Name: Reset Toggles
Logics.Description: Returns Machinist ACR settings to their normal out-of-combat state, including AoE, tool, queen, and support toggles. ForceAOE remains manual.

Logics.Name: Head Graze Interrupt
Logics.Description: Stops interruptible enemy casts with Head Graze when in range.

Logics.Name: Arm's Length Emergency
Logics.Description: Uses Arm's Length as self-defense when stationary below 70 percent HP with two or more mobs on you.

Logics.Name: DPS Toggle Safety
Logics.Description: Maintains Machinist burst, AoE, tool, Queen, Checkmate, and utility toggles in combat so imported or held toggle states cannot strand the job in a passive state.

Logics.Name: Multi-Target AoE Release
Logics.Description: Maintains standard Machinist AoE, tool, Queen, and burst toggles on 2+ enemy pulls while leaving ForceAOE manual.

Items.Name: Raid Mit
Items.Description: Uses Tactician and Dismantle for raidwide damage support.

Items.Name: Self Guard
Items.Description: Uses Second Wind and Arm's Length for personal emergency recovery.

Items.Name: Interrupt
Items.Description: Uses Head Graze on interruptible casts in range.
